answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent identity to use a key generated and held inside a TEE, with remote attestation linking that key to code measured by MRENCLAVE. A mirror virtual machine cannot simply copy the non-exportable key or create an attested hardware identity; adding identities therefore requires additional genuine enclave-capable silicon, not just duplicated VMs. Attestation verifies the enclave state, while key rotation and revocation handle delta changes in trust; copper serial numbers alone are not proof.
